{{Quote|I&hellip; I am Odeph of the Evocii. Leader of the Voam, sacred keeper of histories.|Odeph|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Voam''' was a tribe of [[Evocii]] led by [[Odeph]] in the year [[3643 BBY]], when tensions between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the Evocii on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] were high. In order to maintain peace, Odeph and his tribe allied with [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and attempted to return metals stolen from the Hutts by the Evocii, but failed to talk the other tribes into turning over their metals.
